sar.narrative: This report concerns suspected fraud following an undocumented coordinated pattern on card C13487-K1 held by customer C13487 (internal case AC-HHG-014, opened 2016-11-22). Between 2016-11-15 and 2016-11-22 the card was used for 2 online purchases totalling $187.33 from the device profile `SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080`, marked New for this account and routed through an anonymous proxy: on 2016-11-15 $112.37 online; on 2016-11-22 $74.96 online in billing region 191.0. The same device profile appears on 27 other cards in the current wave, 19 of them active before this case opened, and on 4 closed cases confirmed as fraud in August and September 2016 (CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, CC-3035). The other cards on the profile in this wave are C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K2, C06031-K2, C06650-K2, C06710-K1, C07472-K1, C08168-K1, C08972-K2, C09049-K1, C09195-K1, C09906-K1, C09975-K1, C10020-K1, C10193-K2, C10326-K1, C11082-K1, C11670-K2, C11702-K1, C12645-K1, C12796-K1, C13291-K1. The activity was identified from the bank's graph of shared devices and prior cases rather than from a customer report. The activity is inconsistent with the cardholder's history (prior median purchase $55.92). No prior report has been filed on this customer. OFAC SDN screening of the customer identifier: no match (anonymised identifiers; screening result recorded from the sdn.csv lookup in the live run). Recommended actions: a block and reissue of the card, not yet done and awaiting team-lead approval, internal case opened, 27 connected cards placed under monitoring, case escalated to an analyst.
